title: PawMI - Veterinary Diagnosis App with AI
summary: PawMI is a mobile veterinary diagnosis app combining a React Native/Expo frontend, a FastAPI backend, and a PyCaret-based ML pipeline for symptom-based disease prediction in pets. The ML pipeline's learner.py optionally imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to train and load a synthetic-data generator for augmenting the veterinary training dataset.
